payload.description:
As a CLI user, I want updating an issue to a field value it already has to succeed without writing, so that scripts and agents can be idempotent.

Feature: Idempotent issue update
  Scenario: Updating an issue to its current status succeeds without writing
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    And an issue "kanbus-aaa" exists with status "closed"
    When I run "kanbus update kanbus-aaa --status closed"
    Then the command should succeed
    And issue "kanbus-aaa" should have status "closed"

  Scenario: Update with no flags still fails
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    And an issue "kanbus-aaa" exists
    When I run "kanbus update kanbus-aaa"
    Then the command should fail with exit code 1
    And stderr should contain "no updates requested"
payload.title: Idempotent no-op issue updates
